scope: Proposition 10.8 (Stopped harmonic observable) of the manuscript “Uniform real Lipschitz surfaces on the triangular lattice” (preprints/Uniform-real-Lipschitz-surfaces-on-the-triangular-lattice-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce5ae39087f446a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 102. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a subsequence furnished by Proposition 10.7 and its deterministic height gap l. In this proposition n tends to infinity only along that subsequence. Assume (10.2), the survival bound of Lemma 9.14, and the sequentially uniform field comparisons. Harmonic sampling and boundary marks are as in Lemmas 10.1 and 10.2. Let Hl n,T be the continuum harmonic function in the stopped physical domain with the original exterior values and values +l, −l on the new sides. For every deterministic smooth test f supported in a protected interior ball, sup T E ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓Mn T (f) − ∫ f(z)Hl n,T (z) dz ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ −→ 0. (10.3) The supremum is over stopping rules before a fixed neighborhood of that ball is reached, and the assertion holds in either direction of exploration.
